steps.code:
# Parse the old_songs.txt content to extract song titles and artists
content = file_content['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
songs_to_archive = []
for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        line = line[2:]
        # Split on " by " to get title and artists
        if ' by ' in line:
            title_part, artists_part = line.split(' by ', 1)
            title = title_part.strip()
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
            songs_to_archive.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists})
print(songs_to_archive)

steps.code:
# Search for each song to get its song_id
song_ids_to_archive = []
for song in songs_to_archive:
    # Search by title
    results = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=song['title'], access_token=spotify_token, page_limit=20)
    # Find matching song by checking artists
    found = False
    for r in results:
        # Check if all artists in the song are present in the result's artists
        result_artists = [a['name'] for a in r['artists']]
        if all(artist in result_artists for artist in song['artists']):
            song_ids_to_archive.append(r['song_id'])
            found = True
            break
    if not found:
        print(f"Could not find song: {song['title']} by {song['artists']}")
print("Found song IDs:", song_ids_to_archive)
